faces.name: Sanar, Innovative First-Year
faces.oracleText: Vivid — At the beginning of your first main phase, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X nonland cards, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control. For each of those colors, you may exile a card of that color from among the revealed cards. Then shuffle. You may cast the exiled cards this turn.

faces.name: Sanar, Unfinished Genius
faces.oracleText:
Sanar enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
{T}: Create a Treasure token. Activate only if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.

faces.name: Wild Idea
faces.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
